distinctions: IndicCorpV2 is the ACL 2023 corpus and has a CC-0 statement in its dataset README; it is not the older IndicCorp v1 corpus.
The official IndicCorp v1 site separately states CC BY-NC 4.0; do not apply that notice to v2 or apply v2's CC-0 statement to v1.
A dataset-level license statement is evidence, not automatic proof of rights to every underlying third-party work or of PII/consent clearance.
